clean ΔP recorded; change at OEM limit
F19-3 CDU B2-DH3-Z2-CDU-03 P&ID with the commissioning test points

1 MW plate heat exchanger · FWS 35/45 °C, 14.5 L/s at 600 kW · TCS 45/55 °C, 14.5 L/s normal, 19.33 L/s with one CDU of four stopped · duty and standby pumps · 25 µm TCS filter · FWS strainer 150 to 250 µm
• Test points FT-201, TT-201 and PT-201 on the TCS supply are checked against a clamp-on flow meter and a class A RTD before the heat-load test (±3 % and ±0.3 K).
• Pump changeover P-01 to P-02 must restore TCS flow within the OEM time; the expansion vessel and vent sit on the return, and the fill line carries a fine filter.
instrument bubble (ISA 5.1): letters = measured variable + function
